rows.coder_note: The passages give UKB-PPP as the exposure source and psoriasis as the outcome without naming the outcome GWAS, a release, an accession or a citation for it (datasets are deferred to eTable 3); only participant counts of the cohort are given.

References 5,6 follow a general description of the UKB-PPP project, not an attribution of the pQTL data; reference 6 (Sun 2023) has four dictionary rows and the counts given (54,306; 46,673; 6385; 51,789 after QC; 53,016) are the sample size of none of them.
